findings.title: Download route has no tenant scoping
findings.exploit_scenario: The download route is registered behind the session check only; an authenticated user of another tenant requests /files/<id>/download and receives the file.
findings.recommendation: Compare the file's TenantID with the session tenant before writing the body.

findings.title: Preview error returns internal path to the client
findings.exploit_scenario: GET /files/<own id>/preview while the renderer is down returns 'preview failed: renderer unavailable at /opt/filedrop/bin/thumbd: <id>'.
findings.recommendation: Log the error server side and return a generic 500 message.

findings.title: Preview renders files of other tenants
findings.exploit_scenario: An authenticated user of tenant B requests GET /files/<tenant A file id>/preview; the handler loads the file by id and renders it.
findings.recommendation: Check the file's TenantID against the session tenant before rendering.
